reviews.reviewbody: Thank you for your service. been searching for dubbed dc's for a long time now
Not the spawn kill in part 5

This collection is exactly what I was looking for if I want to watch this anime. Something to note is the mkv files have the Japanese audio with softsubs which isn't mentioned here if anyone prefers to watch in Japanese like I do.

reviews.reviewtitle: best way of watching the series
reviews.reviewbody: very good, i can now watch the full series with the adv dub with still great quality, honestly an objectively better alternative to watching on netflix or buying the physical copies
thank you i was looking for the OG dub! also love how theres just a rebuild movie in there
If you want to listen to the sub, just download the files and open them with VLC media player. There you can change the audio track. I'm so happy this has been uploaded <3

Thank you for uploading this awesome show! <3

I came back to find Evangelion because I had downloaded some mkv's and I needed mp4's for something but I saw that the original one I used got deleted (probs copyright strike :[) and I was devastated, but then I found this one and I got what I needed *plus* director's cut episodes I didn't have before! Works perfectly and just what I needed. :3

reviews.reviewtitle: I wanted to hear the original and you delivered!!!
reviews.reviewbody: I'm a newer anime fan trying to get into older anime and this is a really awesome show! I wanted to watch this one instead of the Netflix dub (Because of the g a y) and im super glad I could find it!

out of all the animes ever, this is the only good one

you can also find end of evangelion here 
https://archive.org/details/end-of-evangelion-adv-high-quality-edit
it´s sad they had to cut off many episodes due to budget

reviews.reviewbody: this anime is just so good but like it makes me feel so many emotions
Thanks a MILLION for this, you ABSOLUTE LEGEND.

I want to thank you for this upload, thanks to you i have been able to what this absolute master pice and experience a level of fylosofi not know to me before. However i would love to know one thing which is if you would be willing to add the end of evangelion movie with the original dub to this .zip or if you would at least be so kind as to share your sorces so i could go look for it my self. thank you for your time and dedication to opensorce content its because of people like you why i love the opensorce comunity.
